facts: This paper proposes a novel method of building polarity-tagged corpus from HTML documents.
The method of building polarity-tagged corpus from HTML documents is fully automatic.
The method of building polarity-tagged corpus from HTML documents can be applied to arbitrary HTML documents.
The idea behind the method of building polarity-tagged corpus from HTML documents is to utilize certain layout structures and linguistic pattern.
The method of building polarity-tagged corpus from HTML documents can automatically extract such sentences that express opinion.
In an experiment, the method of building polarity-tagged corpus from HTML documents could construct a corpus consisting of 126,610 sentences.
